issues.main_description_html:
Summary

When a post is published to Google Street View, the publish flow did not initialise the location from the post itself. The photo was sent with the component's hard-coded default coordinates, no place_id and an empty title. This task makes the Street View publish page initialise its location from the post's saved location.

Problem (before)

In ModalStreetViewComponent, the only code that read locationPost.location_post lived in initMapBox(), which is no longer called (the map step was removed from the flow). As a result, publishStreetView() sent:

Field Value sent
data.lat / data.lng Signal defaults 26.3398, -81.7787, regardless of the post
data.place_id Empty string
data.title Always ''

Additionally, initMapBox() assigned this.place_id = res?.place_id, which overwrote the signal instead of setting it.

Enhancement (after)

  1. Restore location on init: detectCodeStreetView() now calls restoreLocationPost(), which parses the street-view entry from localStorage and sets lng, lat and locationName (place_name, falling back to address) from location_post. This runs both on the first visit and on return from the Google OAuth redirect (?code=).
  2. Resolve the place id: resolvePlaceId() reverse-geocodes the post coordinates through getLocationByLngLtd and stores the result in the place_id signal. It is skipped when a place id is already set or when the post has no location_post.
  3. Publish with the location name: the publish payload now sends title: locationName() instead of an empty string.
  4. Signal fix: place_id is now updated with .set() in initMapBox().
  5. Cleanup: detectCodeStreetView() was flattened with an early return when no stored post exists; duplicated branches and dead commented code were removed.
  6. Account list markup: the "Choose an Account" list now uses real <button> elements (keyboard accessible, labelled delete button), tracks rows by email, and drops a redundant @if and a dead .activeOne class.

Files changed

  • src/app/shared/modals/modal-street-view/modal-street-view.component.ts
  • src/app/shared/modals/modal-street-view/modal-street-view.component.html
  • src/app/shared/modals/modal-street-view/modal-street-view.component.scss

Commit: ec03480

Acceptance criteria

  • Publishing a post that has a location sends that post's latitude and longitude, not the default coordinates.
  • The publish payload contains a non-empty place_id for a post with a location.
  • The publish payload title equals the post's place name (or address when there is no place name).
  • The location is still restored after returning from the Google sign-in redirect.
  • A post without location_post does not trigger a reverse-geocode request and does not throw.
  • Opening the page without a stored post still redirects to the homepage.
  • Multi-panorama posts still show the panorama selection step.
  • Account rows can be selected and deleted with both mouse and keyboard.

Notes / known limitations

  • The place id lookup is delayed by 1200 ms so the search-address token can load first. This is a timing assumption, not a guarantee; if the token request is slower, the lookup runs without a valid token.
  • If the user publishes before the lookup completes, place_id is still empty.
  • refreshTokenAccStreetView() still assigns this.email = data?.email, which overwrites the email signal. Not covered by this task.
